title: Choosing Between PVC and ABS for DWV Systems
description: Drain, Waste, and Vent systems rely heavily on plastic piping like PVC and ABS. ABS is a single-step solvent weld material known for high impact resistance and cold-weather flexibility, making it popular in residential builds. PVC requires a two-step solvent welding process using primer and cement, offering high rigidity and chemical resistance. Direct joining of ABS to PVC requires specific approved transition fittings or specialized transition cement per local code regulations. Understanding pipe material properties helps plumbers select the right system for durability and jobsite efficiency.
